blocks.text:
2 free days on the coast.

Búzios lies approximately 177 km north of Rio. Once a fishing village, it is now a popular resort with many beaches.

You can go surfing, snorkelling, kayaking or water-skiing, or simply relax by the sea. Tropical fish and sea turtles inhabit the waters, and whales can be seen at certain times of year.

In the evening, restaurants and bars open, and the cobbled streets of the resort centre fill with holidaymakers. After Rio, Iguazu and the Amazon, these days give your family a chance to end the trip peacefully by the ocean.

The beaches of Búzios differ from one another. Some are better suited to swimming, while others have waves and more opportunities for active pursuits. You can choose a boat trip with local fishermen and observe underwater life in the clear water.

In this programme, Búzios provides a relaxed ending. After busy journeys and excursions, there is no need to rush from sight to sight: choose a beach to suit the weather, change your plans during the day and simply spend time together by the sea.
